title: Input validation is thorough and panic-free
description:
File: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs

The code handles untrusted input correctly:

1. All slice accesses are bounds-checked before indexing
2. Length validation occurs before arithmetic that could underflow (lines 183-195)
3. Padding bits are verified (line 200-202)
4. Window/FCN values are validated against protocol constraints
5. Tile lengths are validated for both regular and All-1 fragments
6. Buffer size checks occur before writes
7. No panic paths reachable from malformed input

The error handling uses typed Result returns throughout, no unwrap/expect in parsing paths.

This is well-designed defensive code that should survive fuzzing.
